text:
Nina: Hi team — flying into DC on Thursday, working from Georgetown office. Looking for quick lunch pitas/sandwich spots and a casual dinner with a vegetarian option. Budget ~ $20 for lunch. Any favs?

Omar: Wiseguy Pita (M St) is tiny but great for kebab-style pitas, veg falafel option is solid and fills you up. :thumbsup:

Bea: If you want sit-down, Fiola nearby has a good veg pasta but that's pricier. For casual, "Pita Porch" next to the canal does build-your-own and is quick.

Raj: For group dinner, "Kitchen & Keg" on the corner has veggie flatbreads and a private bench area for ~10 people. Not fancy but chill.

Nina: Any late-night spots open? My flight lands late and I might grab something after check-in.

Omar: Georgetown has "Moon Bakery" open until 11 on Thurs with savory pastries and good sandwiches. Travel-friendly.

Bea: Also "Greenfold" is a small vegan deli — great salads and wraps that reheat okay. Closes at 10pm.

Raj: Quick poll: vote with emoji — 1) Wiseguy Pita for solo lunch :one:, 2) Pita Porch group lunch :two:, 3) Kitchen & Keg dinner plan :three:

Omar: :one: from me. cheap + quick.

Bea: :two: if space matters.

Nina: Looks like Wiseguy/Pita Porch are the winners. Does anyone have a direct phone or delivery link?

Omar: Wiseguy page: https://example.delivery/wiseguy-pita-georgetown (call for large orders).

OfficeBot: Reminder — expense policy: meals under $25 can be expensed on travel cards. Save receipts and submit within 10 days. :receipt:

Nina: Great, thanks everyone! Will post if I grab a group dinner so people can join. :wave:
